name: Spider-Man (Stark Enhanced)

abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Ensnare: Kaçış (Evade) etkinleşmesini engeller ve yetenek doğruluğunu azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Hero's Mantra
Great Power (Above 50% Health) - Spider-Man's Taunt Debuffs last 2 seconds longer and each charge of Poise grants him an additional [1,119.5 - 2,212.11] Critical Rating.
Great Responsibility (Below 50% Health) - Spider-Man's chance to Evade an attack increases by a flat +7% and each charge of Poise grants him [56.12 - 121.6] additional Block Proficiency.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked
content: Spider-Man's burgeoning Spider-Sense grants him a Passive 3% chance to Evade an incoming attack.

abilitySections.title: Stark Tech AI
content: Against Special Attacks the Stark AI warns Spider-Man of incoming danger and increases his Evade chance by a flat +60%.
If Spider-Man is struck by a Cosmic Champion or is struck by a Heavy Attack the Stark AI shuts down for 10 seconds while it Reboots and is completely inactive during that time.

abilitySections.title: Smack-Talk
content: Each time Spider-Man Evades an attack or uses the Dexterity Mastery, he gains a charge of Poise. Cooldown: 0.8 Seconds.
Each charge of Poise grants [2,239] Attack rating.
If Spider-Man lands 5 uninterrupted attacks, he converts a Poise charge into a Taunt Debuff on the opponent for 3 seconds. Taunt effects lasts 50% longer against Villain champions.
Dodging back and allowing Spider-Man to idle for 1 seconds allows him to smack-talk his opponent and refresh an active Taunt.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: An EMP webshot drains 45% of the opponent's Power Meter. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 50% chance to Stun the opponent for 2 seconds. The chance is increased by 100% if the Stark AI is active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Electric webshots have a 70% chance to Shock the opponent, dealing [10,075.5] Energy Damage over 6.5 seconds. These Shock effects are overcharged and deal double damage to Robot Champions.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to Ensnare the opponent for 18 seconds. Ensnared Champions suffer 30% reduced Ability Accuracy and cannot trigger Passive Evade effects.
